newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends down after consolidating.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends down after consolidating.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed lower after consolidating in late trading, with players at the sidelines waiting for soyoil's performance tonight and other fresh leads. The market fell in early trading after being hit by weak soyoil overnight. BUt some covering was seen at lower levels, and Sept futures were expected to trade around 1,150 and 1,175 rgt.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Some products business seen in early trade but the market remained cautious.
Players adopted a cautious attitude while waiting for fresh leads, particularly from the soyoil markets.

Some covering and bargain-hunting activity was seen at lower levels, traders said, but they added that the market could move in a boxed-range over the immediate trend in view of rising production and higher stocks due to lack of active demand.

A trader added that the market recovered slightly after a lower opening, on talk of product purchases of RBD palm olein for Aug/Sept shipment which prompted some covering at lower levels in the futures market.

However losses were still posted in the futures market, they said. "Technically, the market is seen holding around current levels with September futures moving in a nine-ringgit range," a trader said.
At the close, the September futures contract was seven ringgit down at 1,155 ringgit ($457.52) a tonne after falling to 1,152 ringgit.
Trading was active with turnover at 2,104 lots.
The physicals market saw fresh buying support in the products sector, with interest confined to nearby CPOs.
Physicals saw July (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,195 ringgit against bids at 1,190 after trading at 1,190.
July (central) saw offers at 1,180 versus 1,177.50 with earlier trades at 1,170 and 1,175.
Aug (south) was offered at 1,192.50 against bids of 1,190 with trades at 1,190. Aug (central) was offered at 1,180 against bids of 1,177.50.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $500 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Aug at $497.50, Sep $497.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $495.
July RBD palm olein saw offers at $542.50, Aug at $540, Sep at $537.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $535. Aug/Sept was traded at $537.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $535.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $382.50, Aug at $377.50 and July/Aug/Sept palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290. -- Tan Lee Lee -603- 275-6834 ($1-2.5245)
